#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

static int N, fifty, hundred, K;
static int memo[2][51][51];
static int memo2[2][51][51][101];
static const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
static long long comb[101][101];

int solve(int t, int f, int h);
int solve2(int t, int f, int h, int r);
long long nCk(int n, int k);
int pow_mod(int x, long long p);

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N >> K;

    for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        int val; cin >> val;
        if(val == 50) fifty++;
        else hundred++;
    }

    for(int i = 0; i <= 2; ++i)
        for(int j = 0; j <= fifty; ++j)
            for(int k = 0; k <= hundred; ++k)
                memo[i][j][k] = -1;

    for(int i = 0; i <= 2; ++i)
        for(int j = 0; j <= fifty; ++j)
            for(int k = 0; k <= hundred; ++k)
                for(int l = 0; l <= 100; ++l)
                    memo2[i][j][k][l] = -1;

    for(int i = 0; i <= 100; ++i)
        for(int j = 0; j <= 100; ++j)
            comb[i][j] = -1;

    long min_steps = solve(0, fifty, hundred);

    if(min_steps >= 1e6) {
        cout << -1 << "\n" << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        int min_r = (int)min_steps;
        cout << min_r << "\n";
        cout << solve2(0, fifty, hundred, min_r) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}

int solve(int t, int f, int h) {
    if(f == 0 && h == 0)
        return 0;

    if(memo[t][f][h] != -1)
        return memo[t][f][h];

    if(t == 1)
        return 1 + (f < fifty ? solve(0, f + 1, h) : solve(0, f, h + 1));

    int ans = (int)1e6;

    for (int i = 0; i <= f; i++) {
        if(i * 50 > K)
            break;
        int j = std::min((K - i * 50) / 100, h);
        int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;

        if ((fifty - f + i > 0 && totalW > 50) || (hundred - h + j > 1 && totalW > 100) || (i == fifty && j == hundred))
            ans = std::min(ans, solve(1, f - i, h - j));
    }
    memo[t][f][h] = ans + 1;
    return memo[t][f][h];
}

int solve2(int t, int f, int h, int r) {
    if(r == 0 && f == 0 && h == 0)
        return 1;
    if(r == 0)
        return 0;
    if(memo2[t][f][h][r] != -1)
        return memo2[t][f][h][r];

    int ans = 0;

    if(t == 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= fifty - f; ++i) {
            if(i * 50 > K)
                break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= hundred - h; ++j) {
                if(i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if(totalW > K)
                    break;
                long long ways = (nCk(fifty - f, i) * nCk(hundred - h, j)) % MOD;
                int res = solve2(0, f + i, h + j, r - 1);
                ans = (int)((ans + 1LL * ways * res) % MOD);
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i <= f; ++i) {
            if(i * 50 > K)
                break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= h; ++j) {
                if(i == 0 && j == 0)
                    continue;
                int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if(totalW > K)
                    break;
                long long ways = (nCk(f, i) * nCk(h, j)) % MOD;
                int res = solve2(1, f - i, h - j, r - 1);
                ans = (int)((ans + 1LL * ways * res) % MOD);
            }
        }
    }
    memo2[t][f][h][r] = ans;
    return ans;
}

long long nCk(int n, int k) {
    if(n < k) return 0;
    if(k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
    if(comb[n][k] != -1) return comb[n][k];

    if(n - k < k)
        return comb[n][k] = nCk(n, n - k);
    long long res = (1LL * n * nCk(n - 1, k - 1)) % MOD;
    res = (res * pow_mod(k, MOD - 2)) % MOD;
    comb[n][k] = res;
    return res;
}

int pow_mod(int x, long long p) {
    if(p == 0) return 1;
    long long ans = 1;
    long long base = x % MOD;
    while(p > 0) {
        if(p & 1) ans = (ans * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        p >>= 1;
    }
    return (int)ans;
}
